Breaking news from the Information Bureau of the Peaceville-41

A few hours ago, a group of aliens was attacked by the unknown citizens dressed in army uniform aircraft during alien's air transport operation of army rations. As a result of the attack the aircraft was heavily damaged and collapsed in flight at high altitude. The crew managed to escape, however, the entire cargo was lost and scattered on a vast territory. After that, the group of stalkers stumbled upon Profeteer Cheshnok's warehouse, where they found several boxes of cologne containing high portion of alcohol. As you might guess, thay were very happy of their finding, and a huge amount of cologne were drawn nearly immediate. After that, all-smashed stalkers headed to Peaceville-41, taking remaining cologne with them. Unfortunately for them, but lucky for UFO Online players, some cologne was lost on their way of celebrating upcoming holiday - Defender of the Fatherland Day!

[b]So, dear players, the coming days will add to the game:

[list]
[*] Lost rations, which can be found in the wastelands. According to unconfirmed reports, the use of a certain amount of rations might to give you a good bonus
[*] 
[*] Unique "Eau de Cologne "Defender" stimulator - for each player as a holiday gift. Also you can find it during combat or buy from the Gold shop
[*] 
[*] Chance of encountering a monsters giving the "Martial spirit" bonus is doubled
[*] 
[*] And, of course, the end-of-the month gold sale - from now no until the end of Sunday, Feb 24 you will get 30% more gold than ordered!

Congratulations, dear players!
[/b]

notes.content:

Today we are releasing one of the largest updates in the history of the project, which received the version number 2.0.0.0! In it you will see:

[list]
[*]Absolutely new role system, which has become much simpler and more understandable
[*]All equipment have been completely rebalanced
[*]The maximum level is now set to 25
[*]New sets of weapons and armor
[/list]

[b]Free genetics and skills reset will be available until October 15[/b]

[list]
[*][b]And also new types of gaming fun:[/b]

A new mission in which you need to take out hordes of aliens, going down to their base level by level and mining the neocrystals, which are used to make schematics of new equipment

[*][b]Hyperportals[/b]

Hyperportals suddenly appeared in the Wasteland (become available after you complete the quest in Avanpost). If you dare to enter you may find yourself in completely unfamiliar territories, and, perhaps, in the already ongoing battle! The brave people who ventured into the hyperportal may find components to produce new items and various other usefulness... or death.

[*][b]New mine[/b]

Under the mine "Podgornaya" a much older mine have been discovered, called "Deep". At this place you will meet high level opponents and some interesting missions

[*][b]Double weekend[/b]

Every Saturday and Sunday experience, loot and cash rewards will be doubled!

[*][b]Difficulty of clan missions was lowered approx. 2 times[/b]
[/list]

Update will be installed today at 13:30 MSK (10:30 UTC)

notes.title: Victory Day!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25233634/59352c1252e89ad5314190e37ae4f0b7d3f7e34b.jpg[/img]

Dear players!

Today we congratulate you on the upcoming holiday - the 72nd anniversary of the Victory in the Great Patriotic War!

In the honor of this event, we are releasing an update in which players of 4+ levels will be able to inflict a crushing defeat to zombie fascists in ordinary battles and get different themed festive items. In addition, 8+ level players will have a chance to detect and destroy secret bunkers, where the hellish nazi creatures in alliance with aliens are developing the latest samples of unique weapons and armor! Of course, the schematics obtained in this way can be used in factories, manufactured items will receive craft bonuses. But keep in mind that solo storming a bunker is extremely dangerous! Also you will get a special game achievement for a successful assault.

And, of course, on the holiday weekend will be held sales - prices are reduced by 2 times:
[list]
    [*]from today until the end of Sunday, May 7 - equipment modifiers!
    [*]from midnight on May 8 until the end of Tuesday, May 9 - genetics and skills dumping
[/list]

Other changes

Clan tournament
[list]
    [*]Members of one alliance will now not be put into the battle against each other
    [*]The winning / losing ratio is taken into account
    [*]Wait timer increased from 5 seconds to 10 minutes
[/list]
These and other rules may be changed depending on the results of future tournaments

Many clan quests was simplified

Now you can find Phoenix schematics in the Replicator Capsules. Also, they will receive craft bonuses when produced

Happy holidays!

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25233634/6f0c4643a38a7018b96038afef7cc56ab0e60019.jpg[/img]

Dear players!

The game update to version 1.8.0.9 will be installed today. 

[b]It will introduce the fourth level implants.[/b] As always, they can be [b]obtained in random encounters or crafted[/b]. In addition, [b]within a day from today's midnight, you will have an unique opportunity to find them in neuroboxes, and there will be also a chance to obtain full set of 6 implants![/b] 

[b]Daily quests rewards have been re-balanced[/b] due to the fact that many players have received super-profits as a result of their abuses. We understand that the reduction of awards will affect those who play fair, but this will help completely "cut off oxygen" to cheaters and bug-users, [b]which will ultimately positively affect the economic situation in the game.[/b]

As we announced earlier, [b]Ufologist will stop buying organic components. The purchases may be restarted in the future[/b], depending on the situation on the components market. 

And also we have some info for those who are waiting for development news: [b]next week we will start testing the next big update![/b]

notes.title: Update 1.8.0.0
notes.content:
[b]Game update was installed successfully. Thank you for your patience[/b]

Dear players, we are glad to announce that the long time of waiting for major game update has come to an end. Today you can take a look at the features list of the UFO Online version 1.8.0.0.

	[b]Implants that improve character's parameters[/b]

You can get them doing random encounters or the "Underground menace" mission. For people who dont want to wait our Premium Shop offers implants box that contains 6 random 1st level implants. Implant that have been once installed can be removed using Neuromatrix. In this case it will not be destroyed. You can remove implant without Neuromatrix too, 
but your implant will be destroyed. Neuromatrices can be found in random encounters and Replicator's capsules. Most rare implants in addition to their own bonuses have set bonuses: the more implants you install from one set the higher bonuses you will have.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25233634/9ea0d3d43f76833548ef6721144853d3202f81f5.png[/img]

	[b]New storyline quests chapter for 14+ lvl characters[/b]

This quests are based on player's ideas and scenarios! To start this storyline you have to speak to the Commander of the Silent Hills.

	[b]Daily quests for characters up to 15 lvl on the map "A" and up to 21 lvl on the map "B"[/b]
[list]
[*]Quest rewards and experience have been rebalanced 
[list]
[*]Map "A": you have to speak to engineers Rabotin or Vorotin and to the miners near Riverside and Oil Creek
[*]Map "B": take in the factory, workshop and laboratory, and also three entrances to the Foothill mine
[/list]
[/list]
	[b]New "Underground menace" mission[/b]

This mission is designed for 5-6 players of level 14 and higher. It takes place at the Foothill mine. As the reward for success you can receive implants, their schematics and manufacturing components 


	[b]New random enounters[/b]

We have added seven new random encounters in this version. Some of them can be encountered all around the game world, some are region-based. Commanders of Riverside and Oil Creek have some information about that. If you will succeed in this encounter you can receive rare implants, their schematics and components

	[b]New achievements[/b]

19 new achievements covering different game aspects: implants, random encounters, drones and quests

	[b]Balance changes: weapons, armor, skills and many more[/b]
[list]
[*] A lot of changes in game formulas
[*] Parameters of the most game items and skill are changed
[*] Snipers have received long-awaited damage boost
[*] Low-level characters parameter boost
[*] Two new skill groups:
[list]
  [*] Ammo effieciency: novice, specialist, expert
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25233634/194169e9d46866b27fd84fa6637438dab1837f3b.png[/img]
   Boosts ammo effects: shellshock, poisoning and damage vs. monsters. Before this update this parameters could be improved only by weapon modifications
  [*] Effects resistance: novice, specialist, expert
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25233634/000addd2cb387e5bc157a3e79d155af806d0f0ed.png[/img]
   Boosts your resistance to shellshock, shock and poison. Before this update this parameters could be improved only by armor modification
[/list]

[*]Skills that are required to use weapons and armor are now have their own bonuses.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25233634/22680d6a505af64fdc60fcd303afad7b64a5c763.png[/img]

[*]Camouflage now affects the chance to hit much more than before update. (If your camouflage parameter is negative you are easy target even at long firing distance. With high camouflage your opponents have much lower chances to hit you)
[/list]
Until the end of December 2016 all players will receive free Reset Skills and Genetics once when log in to the game

	[b]Modifications[/b]

New armor modification available - "Sturdiness". Improves health and medikits efficiency.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25233634/5042700f0a979479da32e573d2fc2e66a196bbd7.png[/img]

	[b]Modifications balance changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Now you can inspect modification parameters in an item info window
[*]Many weapon modifications now have secondary bonuses 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25233634/4488e84f4a22b2ac1838f3eaf44ed025212a36fe.png[/img]
[*]"Poison resistance", "Shock resistance", "Shellshock resistance" are now replaced by "Effects resistance" modification. All item that have one of the older modifications will be automatically converted during update. Modification modules will be converted too. Appropriate market sell orders will be canceled, modules will be converted.
[/list]

	[b]Stims[/b]
[list]
[*] Stims effect duration is lowered (now typical duration is about 4-6 rounds)
[*] Stims bonuses are now balanced better
[*] Intoxication regeneration is lowered
[*] Stims manufacturing costs are lowered
[/list]

	[b]Long-awaited battle mode at the Arena - Capture The Flag![/b]

For players who likes team challenges we are offering CTF battle mode. Here is basic battle principles: players are split into 2 teams, each team have their own red or blue flag initially placed on the special "base" point of the game map. Team goal is to capture the opposite team's flag and take it to their own "base". Goal will be counted only if the team flag was at it's place when the opponets flag was brought in. When one team makes 2 successful touchdowns this team wins the match. If team scores are equal and timelimit is hit the match goes overtime. At the overtime winner is determined by first successful touchdown or the frag count.

	[b]Security zones changes[/b]

When wandering through low-security zones your character will receive "Risk and reward" effect. Experience and loot are increased 1.5 times, and you will loose only 50% trophy items (such as monster body parts or ore) when killed. Beside that, now there are green "safety islands" within the yellow zone. You can use them as shelters when you are at 
danger of attack by other players.
	
	[b]Mining and manufacturing[/b]

[list]
[*]Ore mining balance fixes
[list]
  [*]ore amount increased an the North-West, North and South-West mines
  [*]Iron, Aluminium and Copper amount are increased at the North, South-West and Foothill mines
[/list]
[*]Monster levels at the North and South-West mines are increased to 15
[*]"Martial Spirit" effect now can be gained in mines
[*]"Military midikits" are no more selled by the Ufologist
[/list]

notes.title: Happy birthday, UFO Online!
notes.content:
Dear players! 6th anniversary of the UFO Online will come to us at October, 17. This date is very important to us all, and because of this we want to celebrate this day with our players! During the celebration days you will have a chance to find new random encounter that is taking place at the developers office. This will give you an opportunity to express your earnest affection (using rotten tomatoes) and get a schematic of the brand-new unique weapon "Tesla" (you will need some UFO debris to manufacture this gun) as a reward for your honesty. Also, during the regular battles with monsters, you will get a chance to find schematics of other models of unique weapon and ammo, and the UFO debris that are required to manufacture them. "Tesla" gun and ammo will be also available at the Premium Shop.

We congratulate you, dear players, on the 6th anniversary of UFO Online!

Stay tuned, there will be other special offers during the celebration days.

Update is scheduled to 12:00 UTC (15:00 MSK). Please be patient and sorry for any inconvenience

notes.title: Update 1.7.0.17
notes.content:
[h1][b]Main features[/b][/h1]

[h1]Team join control[/h1]

There's a new button in the battle UI that controls which players can join your team in battle

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25233634/16f85ee530dacd1b6ad7e1f242b7c8c762066db4.png[/img]

By default this button is green - it means that only your gang, clan or alliance members can join your team

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25233634/1f821e68ac95f1672061fe42165b5f90532b06fa.png[/img]

If you press this button it will become orange - in means that any player can join your team (excluding the enemies of your clan or alliance). That is, everything will work as it is working now.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25233634/82d4ba97d7a9e6d9d88d437ee22035161a1885c0.png[/img]

This button is available only for the first player in the team. When this player leaves (killed, fled or won), the button will appear for the next player in the team.

There's also a new option available

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25233634/5f88ed9f5777fd34d022f6935d705502314ea244.png[/img]

Checkbox checked - all your battles will start with "green" button
Checkbox cleared - all your battles will start with "orange" button

[b]Please note that the button has no effect on whether other players can join the opposite team[/b]

[h1]Secure area expanded in the "South-East" mine (near Riverside) and in the "North" mine (near Oil Creek)[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25233634/16f85ee530dacd1b6ad7e1f242b7c8c762066db4.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25233634/1f821e68ac95f1672061fe42165b5f90532b06fa.png[/img]

If you press this button it will become orange - in means that any player can join your team (excluding the enemies of your clan or alliance). That is, everything will work as it is working now.
